updates.title: BI Team Weekly Update — W32
updates.summary: Testing dependencies require attention. Scorecard, Mega Report and MMM Report continue through internal and external testing. Development progressing for Indemnity Report and GP Calculator.
updates.executiveSummary: The BI team update remains Amber. Scorecard, Mega Report and MMM Report continue through internal and external testing, with the data-source transition from OLD UAT to the Training Environment as the next major milestone. Development is progressing for the Indemnity Report and GP Calculator. The Scheduling and Drafting Timeframe Report and OSB Tracker are moving from scoping toward development. Gross Margin and SPG Maintenance remain pending and are exposed to the current margin and claims-data risks.
priorities: Prepare the OLD UAT to Training Environment data-source switch.
Secure sufficient claims and margin testing data.
Continue Indemnity, Scheduling, GP Calculator and OSB development.
Draft the future intranet solution recommendation.
